## 1. Do NOT edit the de-en pack and do NOT add migration v9 for the missing articles
`de-en` is an inherited basic pack that will sit under "Khoá khác"; its stored surfaces ("Freund", "Name") are learner-data keys. Changing them costs a migration and risks progress for no learner benefit. Instead:
- `de-vi` carries its own surfaces with articles (`der Freund`, `der Name`) from `content/de/lexicon`.
- Add `legacySurfaces: ["Freund"]` (aliases) on the German lexemes in `content/de/lexemes.json`; the id registry exposes them and the v8 surface→id mapping consumes them. v8 has never run on a real device (only CI), so extending its data input is safe: add a fixture + test proving `de-en` "Freund" progress maps to `de:w:freund` and survives the RC3-upgrade shard. No v9.
- Validator: every `de-en` surface either maps to a lexeme id (directly or via `legacySurfaces`) or is listed in an explicit `unmapped` file with a reason.

## 2. de-vi lessons: follow the blueprint mix, not a fixed "11 exercises per lesson" template
A uniform 11-step template is exactly what made the inherited packs monotonous (audit §1.2). Use the toolkit `lessons` step with the blueprint's per-section type mix (all 15 types across the course, production in German from Section 1, `flow` concept interleaving in ≥ 25 lessons), lesson-shape gate (≥ 5, varied), position balance, duplicates as errors. Section 1 must still be authored per de-vi unit words (as you said), not translated from de-en.
German-specific gates (add to the de language plugin/linters):
- Nouns always capitalised; every taught noun introduced with its article and plural (`der Tisch, -e`); gender colour-coding consistent with es/fr if used.
- Cases at A1: Nominativ + Akkusativ taught explicitly (den/einen), Dativ only in fixed chunks (mit dem Bus, in der Schule) — linter flags Dativ forms outside declared chunks before Section 4.
- Verb-second word order and separable verbs (aufstehen → ich stehe … auf) each get a concept card + ≥ 6 exercises; Sie/du register is consistent per scenario.
- Variety: standard German (Deutschland) as the production model; Austrian/Swiss forms accepted only as variant notes (`VARIETY.md`), like es.
- LanguageTool (de) on every target string; back-translation pass; tiered review files (`REVIEW-TIER1-vi.md`, `REVIEW-TIER1-de.md`).

## 3. Goethe A1 track — verify against the official documents before authoring items
Use goethe.de's official "Goethe-Zertifikat A1: Start Deutsch 1" Modellsatz / Prüfungsordnung / Durchführungsbestimmungen (fetch them; record URL + date in `formatSource`, `checkedAgainstOfficialGuide: true` only if you actually read them). Model the sections, timings, item counts, task formats and the pass rule exactly as published. Note: Sprechen is a **group** exam in the real test — the app can only simulate it individually; say so in the track description and `KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md`. If goethe.de is unreachable, stop the exam-track step and continue the rest of de-vi; do not author items from memory.
